heading: Restriction on consular certificates
lead: No consular officer of the United States shall grant a certificate for merchandise shipped from countries adjacent to the United States, which have passed a consulate after purchase for shipment.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: R.S. § 2861 derived from act Feb. 22, 1873, ch. 184, § 3, 17 Stat. 474.
